theorem backend.rtRange_full (rv : backend.RView) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) (kb eb : GoString)
    (limit : w64) (h : ↑(backend.bbRange (backend.bkOf rv.snd.bks bi.id) kb eb (backend.rangeLimit
    eb limit)).length = sint.Z (backend.rangeLimit eb limit)) : backend.rtRange rv bi kb eb limit =
    backend.bbRange (backend.bkOf rv.snd.bks bi.id) kb eb (backend.rangeLimit eb limit)

theorem backend.rtRange_rest (rv : backend.RView) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) (kb eb : GoString)
    (limit : w64) (h : ¬↑(backend.bbRange (backend.bkOf rv.snd.bks bi.id) kb eb (backend.rangeLimit
    eb limit)).length = sint.Z (backend.rangeLimit eb limit)) : backend.rtRange rv bi kb eb limit =

    eb limit - W64 ↑(backend.bbRange (backend.bkOf rv.snd.bks bi.id) kb eb (backend.rangeLimit eb
    limit)).length) ++ backend.bbRange (backend.bkOf rv.snd.bks bi.id) kb eb (backend.rangeLimit eb
    limit)
